name: Suduku
author: QPJoy
description: A local-first Sudoku game with 7x7 and 9x9 modes, completion scoring, and marketplace SQLite history.

modes.label: 7x7
modes.rules: Rows and columns must each contain 1-7 once.

modes.label: 9x9
modes.rules: Rows, columns, and 3x3 boxes must each contain 1-9 once.
